title: Import from WordPress
intro: Upload a WordPress export file (Tools → Export → All content in WordPress). Posts, pages and custom post types become entries — check the summary first, then run the import in the background.
fileHint: A WXR .xml file, up to 50 MB. Nothing is imported until you start the import.
tooLarge: The file is larger than 50 MB
totals: {total, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} to import · {attachments, plural, one {# attachment} other {# attachments}} · {skipped} skipped
importMediaHint: Download attachments (images, SVG, PDF, MP4 up to {size} MB each) into the media library and point featured images and content at the new copies.
overwriteHint: Entries whose slug already exists are updated (the old version is kept in their history). Otherwise they are skipped.
run: Start import ({total, plural, one {# item} other {# items}})
categoryPathsHint: Adds a category_paths field with full paths such as “Parent/Child” next to the plain category names. {count, plural, =0 {This file has no nested categories.} one {# nested category in this file.} other {# nested categories in this file.}}
taxonomiesHint: Adds a taxonomies field — terms grouped by taxonomy — to the entries that use them.
taxonomiesNone: This file has no custom taxonomies.
authorsHint: {count, plural, one {# author becomes a wp_author entry} other {# authors become wp_author entries}} (login, display name, first and last name), and each post links to its author through an author_ref field. These are content entries, not login accounts — nobody can sign in with them. Email addresses are not copied.
commentsHint: Approved comments become wp_comment entries: name, text without HTML, date, the comment they reply to and the post they belong to. Commenters’ email and IP addresses are not copied; spam and trashed comments are never imported. In this file: {approved} approved, {pending} pending, {spam} spam or trash.
pendingCommentsHint: Imported as entries waiting for review.
